canonicalFormDecision: The frozen catalogues are stored in the EXTRACTOR'S OWN 2-space JSON, in its explicitly-ordered query order — deliberately NOT key-sorted. Deep-sorting was tried first and broke contract byte-identity, because the compiler copies these objects into the promotion contract and reordering their keys changes its bytes. Observed, then corrected.
compileIsolationDecision: The gate compiles with the DEFAULT relative --out-dir inside a temp cwd. Passing an absolute --out-dir writes that absolute path into the contract's migrations[].path and produces a difference that is not drift. Observed, then corrected.
